instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Catalyst.ai is a specialized junior mining exploration firm focusing on lithium and rare earth mineral prospecting in northern Portugal, currently operating across 15 active concessions in the geological survey and initial drilling phases. We are aggressively seeking to modernize core sample analysis by integrating advanced spectrometry and proprietary AI models for rapid mineral identification, aiming to drastically reduce exploratory risk.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is embedded in our operating rhythm. We run quarterly hackathons focused on automation, maintain a formal patent portfolio for novel survey methods, and have a rotating 'innovation fellow' program where high-potential employees spend 6 months dedicated to exploratory projects. Our last hackathon successfully produced a prototype for automated quality inspection using computer vision that is now in production, reducing defect escape rate by 35%.
answers.strategicGoals: Our primary objective is to reduce operating expenses by 15% over the next two years while maintaining current output levels. We believe there is significant waste in our manual processes and want to identify the highest-ROI automation opportunities across order processing, invoicing, and customer support workflows.
answers.additionalContext: We are 6 months away from launching our Series B fundraising round and need to present a compelling innovation roadmap to investors. The board expects demonstrable progress on at least one major efficiency or growth initiative before the roadshow begins. Speed and visible traction are critical – we need initiatives that can show measurable results within a compressed timeline.
answers.teamSize: Our R&D function consists of 10-12 engineers organized into two squads: one focused on core product innovation and one on exploratory/new business model prototyping. We also have 2 dedicated data engineers building our analytics infrastructure. Innovation projects follow a lean startup methodology with clear go/no-go criteria at 3-month checkpoints.

opportunities.title: Autonomous Geophysical Mapping via Deep Learning
opportunities.rationale: Given the bold risk appetite and long time horizon, deploying AI-driven predictive modeling for geological survey optimization represents a radical shift from current manual surveying. This initiative promises to drastically reduce acquisition costs and operational time associated with exploratory phases.

first_actions: Form a dedicated 'Autonomous Sensing Task Force' (4 engineers)
Secure pilot funding via Series B runway allocation
Define KPI: Reduction in survey data acquisition cost per acre by 25%
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 20% reduction in required drilling locations for preliminary assessment.
milestones: Q1: Data pipeline established and baseline model trained.
Q3: Pilot deployment on two active concessions; validation of cost-saving hypothesis.

opportunities.title: Hyper-Automation of Order & Invoicing Workflows
opportunities.rationale: Addressing the core efficiency goal, implementing RPA and workflow automation tools to streamline back-office functions will yield immediate ROI. This incremental step tackles direct waste in existing operational processes.

first_actions: Audit all manual invoicing/order processing steps
Select and implement a cloud-based RPA solution (e.g., UiPath)
Define KPI: 40% reduction in time spent on administrative order processing.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 40% reduction in administrative overhead labor hours within 12 months.
milestones: Month 3: Full automation of the invoicing cycle for one operational site.
Month 6: Rollout across all three active concessions.

next_steps.action: Conduct a full TCO/ROI analysis for the 'Autonomous Geophysical Mapping' radical project.
Form a cross-functional steering committee focused solely on identifying high-impact automation wins in back-office operations.

key_weaknesses: High dependency on 'formal' process which often delays radical innovation deployment.
Limited internal talent pool specialized in AI/Deep Learning required for autonomous exploration.
Centralized decision-making structure may lead to bottlenecks when balancing efficiency gains across multiple global locations.
Current digital maturity (Level 4) needs expansion into Level 5 capabilities to support the demands of a bold, high-speed roadmap.
